review.en: Five sisters, an entailed estate and two people who misjudge each other at a dance. Austen’s comedy works through dialogue so precise that a single reply can change a reader’s mind about a character, and under the wit runs a clear sense of what marriage meant for women with no money of their own. It is as pleasurable to reread as anything in English.
review.zh: 五个姐妹、一份只能由男性继承的产业，还有两个在舞会上互相看错的人。奥斯汀的喜剧靠对话推进，精确到一句回答就能改变读者对人物的看法；机智之下，是对没有自己财产的女性而言婚姻意味着什么的清醒认识。在英语作品里，它是最经得起重读的乐事之一。
